text:
During a busy evening, many thanks for your detailed note; we looked into it. You were upset that your pet's travel handoff felt rushed and that the comfort checks and boarding guidance did not feel clear enough. That should not leave anyone guessing, and I am sorry for the stress it caused.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has reviewed the handling of the booking and the station notes. Our welfare coordinator checked the comfort record, and the welcome team reviewed how the handoff was managed. What we found is that the pet was cleared for travel, but the flow at the counter could have been smoother, and the explanations should have been steadier from the start.

We take that seriously. When a traveler is moving with a companion animal, the point is to make the process calm, clear, and respectful. If our team gave the impression that your concerns were being brushed aside, that is on us. We have reminded the staff involved to slow down, confirm the comfort details, and explain the next step in plain language before the passenger moves on.

We also want to note that the welfare review is part of routine work, not a special exception. It is there to make sure the animal's needs are checked alongside the travel plan, especially during busy periods when people and pets are both under pressure. The welcome team is meant to support that by preparing passengers for boarding and keeping the handoff organized. When that chain slips, we step in and correct it.

Aurelia Skyways values the care people give their animals, and we want that care matched by our service. We cannot change the inconvenience you already dealt with, but we can acknowledge it and use it to improve the next arrival and boarding experience. If you travel with us again, please let the desk know at the counter that you want the companion animal process handled with extra attention, and we will make sure the team follows through.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
